stages.target: space in front of the robot's chest
stages.affordance: open floor area in front of the robot, below the black chair
stages.description: Starting from the resting position at the bottom-right of the view (cells E5-F6), lift the right hand forward and up about 10-20 cm, keeping the elbow bent, so the hand rises into the lower centre of the view.
stages.completion: The right hand tip is clearly off the lower image edge, at about row 4-5 near the image centre (columns D-E), and the forearm points forward, not down.

stages.target: space straight ahead of the robot at shoulder height
stages.affordance: open space in front of the black chair in the centre of the view
stages.description: Straighten the elbow and push the hand straight forward and a little up, about 30-35 cm forward in total, until the arm is almost fully extended horizontally ahead. Follow the demos' scale: forward ~36 cm, up ~40 cm, from about x=11 to x=45 cm. Keep the hand in the centre of the view and don't let it drift sideways toward the people.
stages.completion: The right arm appears as a long, nearly straight limb from the lower edge of the image, and its hand tip is held still near the image centre (around cells D3-E4), in front of the black chair and not touching any person or object.
